mapper.sql: FROM DWD_STOCK_DAILY d JOIN ODS_C_STORE cs ON cs.ID = d.C_STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ODS_M_PRODUCT mp ON mp.ID = d.M_PRODUCT_ID

when.test: q != null and q.groupByProduct != null and q.groupByProduct

choose.when:
SELECT d.BILLDATE AS "billdate", d.C_STORE_ID AS "storeId", cs.CODE AS "storeCode", cs.NAME AS "storeName", d.M_PRODUCT_ID AS "productId", mp.NAME AS "productCode", mp.GOODSNAME AS "productName", mp.CARD_NAME AS "cardName", mp.SEASON_NAME AS "seasonName", mp.SEX_NAME AS "sexName", mp.YEAR_NO AS "yearNo", MAX(d.PRICELIST) AS "pricelist", SUM(d.TOTAL) AS "total", SUM(d.AMT_LIST) AS "amtList"
GROUP BY d.BILLDATE, d.C_STORE_ID, cs.CODE, cs.NAME, d.M_PRODUCT_ID, mp.NAME, mp.GOODSNAME, mp.CARD_NAME, mp.SEASON_NAME, mp.SEX_NAME, mp.YEAR_NO ORDER BY SUM(d.TOTAL) DESC, d.C_STORE_ID, d.M_PRODUCT_ID
choose.otherwise:
SELECT d.BILLDATE AS "billdate", d.C_STORE_ID AS "storeId", cs.CODE AS "storeCode", cs.NAME AS "storeName", d.M_PRODUCT_ID AS "productId", mp.NAME AS "productCode", mp.GOODSNAME AS "productName", mp.CARD_NAME AS "cardName", mp.SEASON_NAME AS "seasonName", mp.SEX_NAME AS "sexName", mp.YEAR_NO AS "yearNo", d.M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID AS "attrInstanceId", d.PRICELIST AS "pricelist", d.TOTAL AS "total", d.AMT_LIST AS "amtList"
ORDER BY d.TOTAL DESC, d.C_STORE_ID, d.M_PRODUCT_ID, NVL(d.M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID, -1)

mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "storeId", CODE AS "storeCode", NAME AS "storeName" FROM ODS_C_STORE WHERE C_CUSTOMER_ID = 1 ORDER BY CODE
